name: shrike
description: Runtime action governance for Claude Code, from Shrike Security.

plugins.name: shrike-security
plugins.description: Governs the actions Claude Code takes, against the policy you declare. Scans commands, file writes, notebook edits, web searches and fetches, and the brief handed to a sub-agent before they execute, applying your policy in real time to what's allowed, warned, held for approval, or blocked. Shrike doesn't decide on its own authority; you declare the policy and Shrike enforces it. Scans the reply and a sub-agent's report, and keys every scan to the exchange it served. Records what Claude Code's own permission layer decided beside Shrike's verdict. Bundles the governed-tool-use skill and the shrike-mcp security tools.
